blocks.text: Whether your dog is rolling on his back in the grass or playing a game of fetch, the PetSafe Stay & Play Compact Wireless Fence gives your best friend freedom to safely enjoy playing outdoors. With this wireless fence, you can create up to a 3/4-acre circular boundary. An LCD screen displays how far your pet’s play area expands and lets you know if there is a warning or error with your fence. Place the transmitter indoors, plug into an outlet, and setup your new wireless fence in as little as 1-2 hours. If you enjoy camping or traveling in your RV with your dog, take this portable wireless fence with you wherever you go. This fence comes with a rechargeable PetSafe Stay & Play Wireless Fence Receiver Collar. If you have more than 1 pet at home, simply purchase as many additional receiver collars as you need so all of your pets can use the same wireless system.

items.label: 3/4 ACRE OF CIRCULAR COVERAGE
items.value: Adjust the circular boundary range up to 3/4-acre (22-105 ft in all directions) from the placement of the indoor transmitter

items.label: NO DIGGING OR WIRE TO BURY
items.value: Sets up in just a few hours; a wireless boundary allows you to create a secure barrier around your yard to protect your pets without the time or hassle of burying wires

items.label: RECHARGEABLE, WATERPROOF RECEIVER COLLAR
items.value: Wireless fence system comes with 1 waterproof, rechargeable receiver collar that comfortably fits dogs 5 lb and up and adjusts to fit neck sizes 6-28 in

items.label: MULTI-PET CUSTOMIZATION
items.value: Find the best level for each of your pets with 5 adjustable correction levels and tone-only training mode; add additional collars for the whole fur-family

items.label: LCD DISPLAY
items.value: An easy to read display shows you how far your pet’s play area expands; the screen also has warning indicators to let you know if there is an error with the wireless fence system

items.label: PORTABLE
items.value: This portable system is terrific for camping, vacation homes, or anywhere you travel with access to an outlet

items.label: TRUST THE BEST
items.value: Our proprietary circular boundary gently guides your dog back to his play area

items.label: STATIC-FREE REENTRY
items.value: Unlike traditional in-ground fences, this wireless fence allows your pet to return home without being corrected if your pet passes the boundary

items.label: Item Package Dimensions L X W X H
Directions
items.value: Safety Information: In case of frequent power outages, we advise the use of an Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) to avoid a possible unintended activation of the receiver collar.

items.label: Included Components
items.value: PetSafe® rechargeable Li-ion battery; non replaceable, Receiver charger, Training flags, Transmitter with power adaptor, Waterproof receiver with adjustable collar
